summary: Senior Product Manager with a track record of owning complex, technical product areas end to end, from a Faster Payments integration that cut settlement failures by 34% to a card controls launch used by 2.1 million customers. Skilled at turning customer feedback and data into shipped iterations, including an 18% reduction in chargeback disputes, and at leading cross-functional teams of engineers and designers.

bullets: Owned the Faster Payments integration, cutting settlement failures by 34%
Led a team of 6 engineers and 2 designers
Built payments capabilities and led hiring for the team
Reduced chargeback disputes by 18% by redesigning the claims flow
Launched card controls used by 2.1 million customers
